text:
sam_ae: Heads-up — I'm opening a change request for the ratecard format (v4). Main goals: explicit version field, per-region surcharge, and a clearer exception workflow for POCs. Need quick alignment before I land it in staging.
rachel_dealdesk: What specifically changes for DealDesk UI? Can we keep existing quote flows intact?
sam_ae: Yes — quotes should keep working. But we want `rc_version` in each SKU, `region_surcharge` map (e.g. {"APAC": 0.08}), and `exception_controls` to drive buttons in DealDesk.
tomas_revops: Strong +1 for `rc_version`. Also propose `sunset_grace_days` so we can auto-flag SKUs earlier. I suggest 45 days by default.
keiko_pricing: For surcharges: we need rounding rules and precedence when multiple adjustments apply (discounts, surcharges, commit credits). Add `adjustment_order` in metadata?
dana_legal: Also callout for contracts: any surcharge or new billing behavior needs a note in the quote PDF. We should add `billing_notice` that populates the contract template.
sam_ae: Good point. We'll add `billing_notice` string and `adjustment_order` array.
rachel_dealdesk: For exceptions: I'd like machine-actionable flags — `requires_exception:true` and `exception_level:dealdesk|dealdesk+legal|cfo`. Then DealDesk can block or surface a request flow.
tomas_revops: We should encode signer roles, not names. e.g., `signers: [{"role":"AE","min_discount":0},{"role":"DealDesk","min_discount":20}]` — but we can't nest JSON objects per agents.md constraints in exports. In the schema we store it as a JSON-stringified blob, but for this Slack thread just discuss the logical shape.
keiko_pricing: Important: POCs often need temporary discounts. Let's add `poc_override_window_days` and a `poc_discount_cap` percent. Keeps finance from being surprised.
ivy_support: Ops note: schedule wise, we have a maintenance window Thurs 01:00-03:00 UTC for ratecard-service. Please avoid moving big migrations into that window if possible.
sam_ae: OK — we'll aim to push staging tonight and schedule prod for Fri 04:00-05:00 UTC (outside your window).
dana_legal: One more: multi-year commit signatures. If a deal extends >24 months, Legal must approve AMENDED T&Cs. Add `multi_year_requires_legal: true` boolean.
rachel_dealdesk: Workflow question: if an active quote references an SKU that becomes deprecated in v4, what's the UX? Auto-keep until quote signed, or migrate to replacement SKU?
tomas_revops: Default: keep for active quotes; for new quotes show replacement options. Add `deprecation_mode: preserve|migrate|block`. We'll set default to `preserve`.
keiko_pricing: We also need analytics hooks — `rc_tag` and `rc_version` should be joinable to revenue reports. Add `analytics_tags` list.
sam_ae: I'll include `rc_version`, `rc_tag`, `deprecation_mode`, `sunset_grace_days`, `poc_override_window_days`, `poc_discount_cap`, `region_surcharge`, `billing_notice`, `multi_year_requires_legal`, `adjustment_order`, `exception_controls`, and `analytics_tags`.
rachel_dealdesk: Can we encode approval routing so DealDesk can auto-create the Jira ticket? Something like `approval_route: ["dealdesk","legal"]` and `auto_create_ticket:true` with `ticket_template_id`.
dana_legal: Fine with auto-ticketing as long as templates include legal checklist items. We'll provide a template ID.
ivy_support: Ops checklist: backup ratecard DB, dry-run migration in staging, run smoke tests with 3 sample quotes (POC discount, multi-year commit, APAC surcharge). Monitor error budget (we have 20m/month for ratecard-service).
sam_ae: Draft metadata example (staging):
```json
{
  "sku": "redwood-embed-pro",
  "rc_version": "v4",
  "rc_tag": "rc-autumn-2026",
  "region_surcharge": {"APAC": 0.08, "EMEA": 0.02},
  "deprecation_mode": "preserve",
  "sunset_grace_days": 45,
  "poc_override_window_days": 30,
  "poc_discount_cap": 35,
  "multi_year_requires_legal": true,
  "billing_notice": "APAC customers: additional regional surcharge may apply.",
  "analytics_tags": ["v4-rollout","surcharge-enabled"]
}
```
keiko_pricing: That looks solid. For `poc_discount_cap` we should limit per-AE quota as well; we'll handle allocation in the DealDesk UI.
tomas_revops: I'll update the documentation and migration plan. Key migration task: preserve historical v3 entries and keep a compatibility layer for commit-crediting until we fully flip.
rachel_dealdesk: I'll prepare the Jira ticket template and the DealDesk UI change list. Also pushing a small banner to reps when they pick a deprecated SKU.
dana_legal: We'll review the `billing_notice` wording and supply the contract clause.
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: staging=2026-05-06T22:00:00Z-23:00:00Z, production tentative=2026-05-08T04:00:00Z-05:00:00Z
sam_ae: Thanks. Can someone draft a short customer-facing deprecation notice for AE use? Minimal text so reps can paste.
rachel_dealdesk: Draft for reps: "Heads up — the SKU <sku> will be retired on <date>. Existing quotes remain valid. Contact your AE for migration options or compatible SKUs." I'll refine once we finalize `sunset_grace_days`.
keiko_pricing: Minor ask: define exact arithmetic for applying % discounts then surcharges and rounding (we'll default to two decimals, round half-up).
ivy_support: All set on the ops side. We'll run the staging migration tonight and report results in #deploy-status.
keiko_pricing: Acks from Pricing.
dana_legal: Acks from Legal.
tomas_revops: Acks from RevOps. I'll schedule a 30-min sync after staging smoke tests if anything looks off.
rachel_dealdesk: Acks. I'll create the Jira template and link it in this thread once ready.
sam_ae: Perfect — thanks team. Will post a follow-up after staging completes. :rocket:
